title: Cassava
body: Use clean planting material, inspect for cassava mosaic and bacterial blight symptoms, remove severely affected plants, and consult an extension worker before treatment.
description_en: Use clean planting material, inspect for cassava mosaic and bacterial blight symptoms, remove severely affected plants, and consult an extension worker before treatment.

title: Maize
body: Monitor leaves and cobs for insect damage, leaf spots, and stalk problems. Use integrated pest management and safe storage to reduce mould and aflatoxin risk.
description_en: Monitor leaves and cobs for insect damage, leaf spots, and stalk problems. Use integrated pest management and safe storage to reduce mould and aflatoxin risk.

body: Use locally recommended varieties, maintain field sanitation, monitor for shoot fly and fungal disease symptoms, and seek extension advice before applying products.
description_en: Use locally recommended varieties, maintain field sanitation, monitor for shoot fly and fungal disease symptoms, and seek extension advice before applying products.

title: Cowpea
body: Inspect leaves, stems, pods, and roots. Use resistant varieties, clean seed, crop rotation, and integrated pest management; follow locally approved product labels.
description_en: Inspect leaves, stems, pods, and roots. Use resistant varieties, clean seed, crop rotation, and integrated pest management; follow locally approved product labels.

title: Rice
body: Use clean seed, balanced nutrition, appropriate spacing, and field monitoring for blast and bacterial leaf blight. Confirm a diagnosis before treatment.
description_en: Use clean seed, balanced nutrition, appropriate spacing, and field monitoring for blast and bacterial leaf blight. Confirm a diagnosis before treatment.

title: Yam
body: Select healthy seed yam, avoid damaged setts, use clean tools, and remove visibly diseased planting material. Ask an extension worker about local disease pressure.
description_en: Select healthy seed yam, avoid damaged setts, use clean tools, and remove visibly diseased planting material. Ask an extension worker about local disease pressure.

body_ha: Zabi irin doya mai koshin lafiya, guji wadda ta lalace, yi amfani da kayan aiki masu tsafta, kuma cire doya mai cuta don guje wa yaduwa.

title: Millet
body: Use adapted varieties, maintain weed and field sanitation, monitor for downy mildew and smut symptoms, and use only approved control measures.
description_en: Use adapted varieties, maintain weed and field sanitation, monitor for downy mildew and smut symptoms, and use only approved control measures.
description_ha: Shuka irin gero da ya dace da yankinka, cire ciyawa a kan kari, duba ciwon baƙin gari ko amosanin gona, kuma bi shawarar kariya.
body_ha: Shuka irin gero da ya dace da yankinka, cire ciyawa a kan kari, duba ciwon baƙin gari ko amosanin gona, kuma bi shawarar kariya.

title: Pepper — Bacterial spot
body: Symptoms: small, water-soaked leaf spots turning dark brown with yellow halos; scabby fruit lesions. Remove infected leaves/fruit, avoid overhead water, and rotate 2-3 seasons away from nightshades.
description_en: Symptoms: small, water-soaked leaf spots turning dark brown with yellow halos; scabby fruit lesions. Remove infected leaves/fruit, avoid overhead water, and rotate 2-3 seasons away from nightshades.

body_ha: Alamomi: ƙananan tabo a kan ganye masu zama duhu da kewayen ruwan dorawa; kuraje a jikin barkono. Cire ganyen da ya kamu, guji zuba ruwa a saman ganye, kuma jujjuya shuka.

title: Tomato — Early blight
body: Symptoms: brown lesions with concentric target rings on older leaves with yellow halo. Prune lower leaves, avoid soil splash by mulching, and rotate crops.
description_en: Symptoms: brown lesions with concentric target rings on older leaves with yellow halo. Prune lower leaves, avoid soil splash by mulching, and rotate crops.
description_ha: Alamomi: baƙaƙen tabo masu zobe a tsofaffin ganye tare da launin dorawa. Yanke ganyen ƙasa, rufe ƙasa da ciyawa don guje wa dukan ruwa, kuma jujjuya gona.

title: Onion (Irrigated Dry Season)
body: Vital dry-season cash crop in Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi, and Kaduna. Grow in raised beds with sandy-loam soil. Transplant healthy 6-8 week seedlings in Nov-Dec. Maintain regular shallow furrow irrigation every 5-7 days. Protect against Purple Blotch and Thrips using crop rotation and neem extract. Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest and cure bulbs in shade.
description_en: Vital dry-season cash crop in Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi, and Kaduna. Grow in raised beds with sandy-loam soil. Transplant healthy 6-8 week seedlings in Nov-Dec. Maintain regular shallow furrow irrigation every 5-7 days. Protect against Purple Blotch and Thrips using crop rotation and neem extract. Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest and cure bulbs in shade.
description_ha: Amfanin gona mai matuƙar muhimmanci a lokacin rani a Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi, da Kaduna. Shuka a kan kanta mai ƙasa mai laushi. Dashe kananan shuke-shuke masu makonni 6-8 a watannin Nuwamba da Disamba. Shayar da ruwa a magudana duk bayan kwanaki 5-7. Yi kariya daga ciwon duhun ganye da ƙwari ta amfani da ruwan Dogon Yaro. Tsayar da shayarwa kwanaki 14 kafin girbi, kuma busar da albasar a inuwa.

Tsayar da shayarwa kwanaki 14 kafin girbi, kuma busar da albasar a inuwa.

title: Onion — Purple Blotch (Alternaria porri)
title_ha: Albasa — Duhun Ganye mai Ruwan Hoda
hausa: Albasa — Duhun Ganye mai Ruwan Hoda
body: Symptoms: small water-soaked sunken lesions on leaves turning purple to dark brown with concentric rings and yellow halos. Leaves yellow, girdle, and fall over prematurely. Prevention: spray neem seed kernel extract or copper hydroxide early; avoid furrow flooding onto foliage; rotate away from allium crops.
description_en: Symptoms: small water-soaked sunken lesions on leaves turning purple to dark brown with concentric rings and yellow halos. Leaves yellow, girdle, and fall over prematurely. Prevention: spray neem seed kernel extract or copper hydroxide early; avoid furrow flooding onto foliage; rotate away from allium crops.
description_ha: Alamomi: tabo mai ruwa da ke komawa ruwan hoda da zobe a kan ganyen albasa. Ganye na zama rawaya kuma ya kwanta kafin lokaci. Kariya: fesa ruwan 'ya'yan Dogon Yaro ko maganin jan ƙarfe (copper); guji ambaliyar ruwa a saman ganye.
body_ha: Alamomi: tabo mai ruwa da ke komawa ruwan hoda da zobe a kan ganyen albasa. Ganye na zama rawaya kuma ya kwanta kafin lokaci. Kariya: fesa ruwan 'ya'yan Dogon Yaro ko maganin jan ƙarfe (copper); guji ambaliyar ruwa a saman ganye.

title: Onion — Thrips Infestation (Kwarin Albasa)
title_ha: Albasa — Farin Kwari a Tsakanin Ganye
hausa: Albasa — Farin Kwari a Tsakanin Ganye
body: Symptoms: minute yellowish/brown insects feeding deep inside leaf sheaths causing silvery white patches, distorted curly leaves, and reduced bulb sizing. Prevention: spray garlic-chili or neem oil solution early morning; destroy weeds around field borders.
description_en: Symptoms: minute yellowish/brown insects feeding deep inside leaf sheaths causing silvery white patches, distorted curly leaves, and reduced bulb sizing. Prevention: spray garlic-chili or neem oil solution early morning; destroy weeds around field borders.
description_ha: Alamomi: kananan ƙwari masu cin ganye a cikin kwarin albasa da ke barin fari kamar azurfa, karkacewar ganye, da rashin girman albasa. Kariya: fesa tafarnuwa da barkono ko man Dogon Yaro da sassafe; cire ciyawa a gefen gona.
body_ha: Alamomi: kananan ƙwari masu cin ganye a cikin kwarin albasa da ke barin fari kamar azurfa, karkacewar ganye, da rashin girman albasa. Kariya: fesa tafarnuwa da barkono ko man Dogon Yaro da sassafe; cire ciyawa a gefen gona.

title: Onion — Post-Harvest Curing & Ventilated Barn Storage
title_en: Onion — Post-Harvest Curing & Ventilated Barn Storage
title_ha: Albasa — Busarwa a Inuwa da Ajiyarta a Rumbu
hausa: Albasa — Busarwa a Inuwa da Ajiyarta a Rumbu
body: To prevent neck rot and sprouting: harvest when 50-70% of leaf tops fall over. Cure in shade with good airflow for 10-14 days until neck is completely dry and paper-like. Store on elevated slatted bamboo/wooden racks inside well-ventilated mud barns away from direct floor contact.
description_en: To prevent neck rot and sprouting: harvest when 50-70% of leaf tops fall over. Cure in shade with good airflow for 10-14 days until neck is completely dry and paper-like. Store on elevated slatted bamboo/wooden racks inside well-ventilated mud barns away from direct floor contact.
description_ha: Don hana rubewar wuya da tsirowa: girbe lokacin da kashi 50-70% na ganyen ya kwanta. Busar a inuwa mai iska na kwanaki 10-14 har sai wuyan ya bushe sosai. Ajiye a kan gadon katako ko gora a cikin rumbu mai iska ba tare da taba kasa ba.

title: Tomato — Late blight
body: Symptoms: water-soaked rapidly expanding dark lesions with fuzzy white undersides during humidity. Remove hot spots promptly, increase airflow, and avoid wet foliage.
description_en: Symptoms: water-soaked rapidly expanding dark lesions with fuzzy white undersides during humidity. Remove hot spots promptly, increase airflow, and avoid wet foliage.

title: Malaria warning signs
body: Fever, chills, and headache can occur with malaria but are not specific. Severe fatigue, confusion, convulsions, breathing difficulty, dark or bloody urine, jaundice, or abnormal bleeding require emergency care.
description_en: Fever, chills, and headache can occur with malaria but are not specific. Severe fatigue, confusion, convulsions, breathing difficulty, dark or bloody urine, jaundice, or abnormal bleeding require emergency care.

title: Anaemia
body: Tiredness, weakness, dizziness, and shortness of breath can have many causes. A health worker should confirm anaemia with appropriate testing and identify the cause.
description_en: Tiredness, weakness, dizziness, and shortness of breath can have many causes. A health worker should confirm anaemia with appropriate testing and identify the cause.

title: Tuberculosis (TB)
body: Persistent cough for more than 2 weeks, fever, night sweats, weight loss, or coughing blood need assessment at a health facility. Do not rely on an app to confirm or exclude TB.

title: Cholera and acute diarrhoea
body: Repeated watery diarrhoea can rapidly cause dehydration. Use safe oral rehydration salts (ORS) with clean water, and seek urgent care for severe dehydration, inability to drink, or blood in stool.

title: Jaundice (Yellow eyes / skin)
title_ha: Shawara (Launin Rawaya a Idanu ko Fata)
body: Yellowing of the eyes or skin has several causes, including hepatitis, liver disease, and severe infections. Arrange prompt clinical testing, especially with fever or confusion.

title: Diabetes risk signs
body: Increased thirst, frequent urination, unexplained weight loss, slow-healing sores, or blurred vision need clinical laboratory testing. Early detection prevents complications.
description_en: Increased thirst, frequent urination, unexplained weight loss, slow-healing sores, or blurred vision need clinical laboratory testing. Early detection prevents complications.

title: Skin concerns and infections
title_ha: Kula da Matsalolin Fata da Kuraje
body: Keep affected skin clean and dry. Avoid sharing creams or applying unprescribed steroids. Seek care for spreading redness, pus, severe pain, fever, or swelling around the face or eyes.
description_en: Keep affected skin clean and dry. Avoid sharing creams or applying unprescribed steroids. Seek care for spreading redness, pus, severe pain, fever, or swelling around the face or eyes.

title: High blood pressure
body: High blood pressure usually has no outward warning signs. It must be checked with a validated blood pressure cuff at a clinic. Regular physical activity and low salt intake help prevention.
description_en: High blood pressure usually has no outward warning signs. It must be checked with a validated blood pressure cuff at a clinic. Regular physical activity and low salt intake help prevention.

title_ha: Alamomin Hadari ga Mata Masu Ciki
hausa: Alamomin hadari ga mata masu ciki

title: Rainy-season planting window
body: Use local rainfall onset, soil moisture, crop duration, and extension advice rather than a fixed calendar date. Plant when the soil has received enough reliable rain for germination and replanting risk is low.
description_en: Use local rainfall onset, soil moisture, crop duration, and extension advice rather than a fixed calendar date. Plant when the soil has received enough reliable rain for germination and replanting risk is low.

title: Rainy-season young-crop care
title_ha: Kula da Ƙananan Tsirrai a Damina
body: After establishment, prioritize weeding, gap filling, drainage, scouting for insects and disease, and protecting seedlings from runoff. Weather forecasts are guidance, not a guarantee.
description_en: After establishment, prioritize weeding, gap filling, drainage, scouting for insects and disease, and protecting seedlings from runoff. Weather forecasts are guidance, not a guarantee.

body_ha: Bayan fitowar shuka, a mai da hankali kan cire ciyawa da wuri, gyara ramukan da ba su fito ba, bude magudanar ruwa, da duba kwari da cututtuka akai-akai domin kiyaye tsirran daga ambaliya.

title: Dry-season irrigation planning
title_ha: Noman Rani da Tsarin Ban Ruwa
body: Use irrigation only where water access and safety are confirmed. Plan water, mulch, shade, pest scouting, and harvest timing. Avoid planting water-demanding crops when water is uncertain.
description_en: Use irrigation only where water access and safety are confirmed. Plan water, mulch, shade, pest scouting, and harvest timing. Avoid planting water-demanding crops when water is uncertain.
description_ha: Yi noman rani a inda aka tabbatar da samun ruwa mai inganci. Tsara yawan ruwan da za a bayar, lullube kasa da ciyawa (mulching) don rike laima, da kiyaye kwarin rani kamar thrips a albasa.
body_ha: Yi noman rani a inda aka tabbatar da samun ruwa mai inganci. Tsara yawan ruwan da za a bayar, lullube kasa da ciyawa (mulching) don rike laima, da kiyaye kwarin rani kamar thrips a albasa.

title: Harmattan precautions
title_ha: Kariya a Lokacin Hunturu da Kura (Harmattan)
hausa: Kariya a lokacin hunturu da kura
body: Dry dusty air and strong winds increase moisture loss and reduce visibility. Protect seedlings with windbreaks, maintain mulch, and avoid spraying agrochemicals when wind can carry drift to houses, animals, or water.
description_en: Dry dusty air and strong winds increase moisture loss and reduce visibility. Protect seedlings with windbreaks, maintain mulch, and avoid spraying agrochemicals when wind can carry drift to houses, animals, or water.
description_ha: Iska mai bushewa da kura na saurin shanye laimar kasa. A kafa shingen kare iska, a lullube kasa da ciyawa, kuma a guji fesa magungunan feshin noma lokacin da iska ke da karfi don kada ta kai shi ga gidaje ko dabbobi.
body_ha: Iska mai bushewa da kura na saurin shanye laimar kasa. A kafa shingen kare iska, a lullube kasa da ciyawa, kuma a guji fesa magungunan feshin noma lokacin da iska ke da karfi don kada ta kai shi ga gidaje ko dabbobi.

title: Harvest and drying timing
title_ha: Lokacin Girbi da Busar da Amfanin Gona
hausa: Girbi da busar da amfanin gona
body: Harvest timing depends on crop maturity, grain moisture, weather, pests, and storage capacity. Plan clean drying surfaces and hermetic bags or safe granaries before harvesting to prevent mould.
description_en: Harvest timing depends on crop maturity, grain moisture, weather, pests, and storage capacity. Plan clean drying surfaces and hermetic bags or safe granaries before harvesting to prevent mould.
description_ha: Lokacin girbi ya dogara da balagar shuka, bushewar hatsi, da yanayi. Samar da shimfidar shanya mai tsafta da buhunan kariya (PICS bags) ko rumbun da babu kwari kafin girbi don kare hatsi daga zubewa ko zama guba.
body_ha: Lokacin girbi ya dogara da balagar shuka, bushewar hatsi, da yanayi. Samar da shimfidar shanya mai tsafta da buhunan kariya (PICS bags) ko rumbun da babu kwari kafin girbi don kare hatsi daga zubewa ko zama guba.

title: Climate-aware farm planning
body: Compare forecast rainfall and temperature with past local experience, keep a simple farm diary, diversify crop varieties and planting dates, and never rely solely on a single weather report.
description_en: Compare forecast rainfall and temperature with past local experience, keep a simple farm diary, diversify crop varieties and planting dates, and never rely solely on a single weather report.

title: Drinking water safety
body: Clear-looking water is not proven safe. Keep drinking water protected from surface runoff, boil or use approved chlorine purification tablets, store in clean covered containers with a tap or ladle.
description_en: Clear-looking water is not proven safe. Keep drinking water protected from surface runoff, boil or use approved chlorine purification tablets, store in clean covered containers with a tap or ladle.
description_ha: Ruwan da ke da haske ba lallai yana nufin ba shi da kwayoyin cuta ba. Tafasa ruwan sha ko zuba maganin tsaftace ruwa (WaterGuard/Chlorine), sannan a ajiye a randa ko jarka mai murfi da kofin debawa mai tsafta.
body_ha: Ruwan da ke da haske ba lallai yana nufin ba shi da kwayoyin cuta ba. Tafasa ruwan sha ko zuba maganin tsaftace ruwa (WaterGuard/Chlorine), sannan a ajiye a randa ko jarka mai murfi da kofin debawa mai tsafta.

title: Water contamination warning signs
body: Unusual colour, foul smell, strange taste, dead fish/frogs, chemical runoff, flooding, or proximity to latrines are urgent reasons to avoid drinking water until tested and treated.
description_en: Unusual colour, foul smell, strange taste, dead fish/frogs, chemical runoff, flooding, or proximity to latrines are urgent reasons to avoid drinking water until tested and treated.
description_ha: Sauyin launi, wari mara dadi, dandanen daban, matattun kifi ko kwadi a ciki, ambaliyar ruwa kusa da masai (bandaki) alamomi ne da ke nuna cewa ruwan yana da hadari kuma bai dace a sha ba har sai an tace an kuma tafasa.
body_ha: Sauyin launi, wari mara dadi, dandanen daban, matattun kifi ko kwadi a ciki, ambaliyar ruwa kusa da masai (bandaki) alamomi ne da ke nuna cewa ruwan yana da hadari kuma bai dace a sha ba har sai an tace an kuma tafasa.

title: Poultry record keeping
body: Track flock size, bird age, Newcastle and Gumboro vaccination dates, feed consumption, egg count, illnesses, and mortality. Isolate sick birds immediately and contact veterinary officers if deaths spike.
description_en: Track flock size, bird age, Newcastle and Gumboro vaccination dates, feed consumption, egg count, illnesses, and mortality. Isolate sick birds immediately and contact veterinary officers if deaths spike.
description_ha: Rubuta yawan kaji, shekarunsu, ranakun allurar rigakafin cutar ciwon kaji (Newcastle da Gumboro), yawan abincin da suke ci, da kwan da suke shimfida. Ware kazar da ba ta da lafiya nan take domin kare sauran.
body_ha: Rubuta yawan kaji, shekarunsu, ranakun allurar rigakafin cutar ciwon kaji (Newcastle da Gumboro), yawan abincin da suke ci, da kwan da suke shimfida. Ware kazar da ba ta da lafiya nan take domin kare sauran.

title: Poultry biosecurity and hygiene
title_ha: Tsafta da Kariya a Ɗakin Kaji
hausa: Tsafta da kariya a dakin kaji
body: Limit unnecessary visitors, sanitize boots before entry, keep wild birds out of pens, quarantine new birds for 14 days, dispose of dead birds by burying or burning, and wash hands thoroughly.
description_en: Limit unnecessary visitors, sanitize boots before entry, keep wild birds out of pens, quarantine new birds for 14 days, dispose of dead birds by burying or burning, and wash hands thoroughly.
description_ha: Hana shige da ficen baki marasa dalili a dakin kaji, wanke takalma da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta, hana tsuntsayen daji shiga, ware sabbin kaji na kwanaki 14 kafin hada su, sannan a binne duk kazar da ta mutu.
body_ha: Hana shige da ficen baki marasa dalili a dakin kaji, wanke takalma da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta, hana tsuntsayen daji shiga, ware sabbin kaji na kwanaki 14 kafin hada su, sannan a binne duk kazar da ta mutu.

title: Poultry heat and harmattan management
title_ha: Kula da Kaji a Lokacin Zafi ko Hunturu
hausa: Kula da kaji a zafi ko hunturu
body: Provide adequate ventilation without cold drafts, clean and cool drinking water with electrolytes on hot days, and keep litter dry. Watch for panting, lethargy, or nasal discharge.
description_en: Provide adequate ventilation without cold drafts, clean and cool drinking water with electrolytes on hot days, and keep litter dry. Watch for panting, lethargy, or nasal discharge.
description_ha: Samar da iska mai kyau a dakin kaji ba tare da sanyin dare ya shige su kai-tsaye ba. Bada ruwan sha mai sanyi da bitamin (electrolytes) a lokutan zafi, sannan kiyaye shimfidar kasan dakin daga jika.
